name: Kasane
summary: 将彩色板块叠成目标图案的益智游戏。官方披露标题画面、部分界面背景、商店美术和背景音乐使用生成式 AI；谜题由确定性求解器生成。

sources.label: Steam 商店完整 AI 披露
sources.excerpt: The artwork in this game — the title screen, the application icon, the difficulty-selection backgrounds, the plate textures behind buttons and panels, and the store art — and background music tracks were created with generative AI tools, then selected and adjusted by the developer. The puzzle boards, pieces and target patterns are drawn procedurally, the sound effects are synthesized at runtime, and every puzzle is produced by a deterministic solver. No content is generated live during gameplay.
